Bnei Sakhnin F.C. is an Israeli professional football club based at the Doha Stadium in Sakhnin. They are the most successful club among the Arab-Israeli clubs in the country, having won the State Cup in 2004. The club was formed in 1991 by a merger of Maccabi Sakhnin and Hapoel Sakhnin. The majority of its fans are Israeli Arabs.
